name: @Option
designer: MUST build the form from the server `properties`, never from Java classes; MUST NOT invent option names; MUST treat names starting with `$` as technical (see `CFG-016`).
runtime: MUST provide configuration values through the component manager (flat map, see `CFG-002`); `@Option` fields MUST NOT be `final` (`NoFinalOptionValidator`).

name: Option path and flat configuration map syntax
designer: MUST serialize user input to this flat form (prefix rules and `[i]` indexes) for `/action/execute` and for saved configuration; MUST use the same paths for `@Suggestable`/`@Updatable`/`@ActiveIf` targets (relative-path syntax in [05](../05-configuration-and-ui.md)).
runtime: MUST convert the flat map to the component object graph via the component manager (`ReflectionService`); unknown keys are ignored (inferred), missing values keep field defaults.

name: Parameter types and type mapping
designer: MUST support at least `STRING`, `NUMBER`, `BOOLEAN`, `ENUM`, `OBJECT`, `ARRAY`; MUST treat unknown `type` values as `STRING` (inferred).
runtime: MUST rely on the component manager conversion (property editors); MUST NOT reimplement type conversion.

name: @DefaultValue
designer: MUST pre-fill the field with `ui::defaultvalue::value` when present, else with `defaultValue`; MUST convert per property type.
runtime: none (the runtime receives the value the designer stored; the Java field initializer applies if absent).

name: @Hidden
designer: MUST NOT show the field to the user; MUST still keep it in the model and send its value in flat configuration.

name: @OptionsOrder
designer: MUST render children in this order when no grid layout applies (one widget per row).

name: @ConfigurationType (meta-annotation)
designer: MUST use `configurationtype::type` to recognize reusable configuration nodes inside a component form.

name: @DataStore
designer: MUST offer datastore reuse (create/edit/pick a saved datastore) and MUST offer a connection test button when a health check of the same name exists.
runtime: MUST feed the datastore values as part of the flat configuration of the referencing component.

name: @DataSet
designer: MUST allow selecting/creating a dataset for input/output components and SHOULD pass the dataset configuration to schema discovery.
runtime: MUST inject the dataset values as part of the component configuration.

name: @DatasetDiscovery
designer: MAY use it to let the user browse available datasets of a datastore (pairs with `ACT-009`).
runtime: MUST honor `retrieveDataset` semantics documented in `CFG-011` if it executes discovery components.

name: DatasetDiscoveryConfiguration
designer: MUST render it like any boolean option.
runtime: MUST pass its value like any option.

name: @DynamicDependenciesConfiguration
designer: MAY call the dynamic dependencies action with this configuration to resolve extra jars before running.
runtime: SHOULD resolve the returned GAVs into the component classloader (details: SVC/LCM catalogs).

name: @ConnectorRef and ConnectorReference
designer: MAY offer a connector picker filling the fields; MUST otherwise render normal strings.

name: Property definition and metadata model (SimplePropertyDefinition)
designer: MUST build forms and default values from these records; MUST NOT expect `validation::*` keys in `metadata` (they are in `validation`); note the generated documentation pages (`generated_constraints.adoc`) still show `validation::*` web keys (documented as a discrepancy).

name: ParameterExtensionEnricher SPI
runtime: MUST keep `ServiceLoader` discovery of built-in enrichers when embedding `component-runtime-manager`; MAY register custom enrichers (recommended: one key prefix per extension).

name: Built-in technical options ($maxBatchSize, $maxRecords, $maxDurationMs, $lang)
designer: MUST render them like normal options (they appear in `properties`) and MUST send them back in the flat configuration; MUST NOT treat the `$` prefix as an error.
runtime: MUST honor `$maxBatchSize` for group sizing, `$maxRecords`/`$maxDurationMs` for stopping infinite sources (Beam reference: `BaseProcessorFn`, `TalendIO`).

name: Configuration type tree (ConfigTypeNode)
designer: MUST browse the tree to offer reusable datastores/datasets, MUST resolve `parentId`/`edges`; MUST store the node `version` with saved instances and migrate on version change.

name: ConfigurationMapper (object to flat map)
designer: none (browser hosts implement the same rules by hand).
runtime: MAY use it to build configuration maps from typed objects (tests, adapters).

name: Datastore/dataset design rules (build-time)
designer: MAY rely on these invariants (an input always has a dataset which contains a datastore).
